claims.claim: No o, I tested it myself yesterday, everything I said is true.
claims.evidence: Seller text only; photo 0 does not show any test or diagnostic output.

claims.claim: Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened (re-stated by seller).
claims.evidence: Photo 0 cannot confirm running sound, mileage, tamper/opening status, or internal faults.

risks.risk: Working/no-knock status cannot be verified without a running proof; internal faults may exist despite a claim.
risks.proof: Request a short video of the engine starting from cold (or at least start + stable idle) and/or a diagnostic scan screenshot showing no critical fault codes.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst-case: treat as faulty/needs overhaul).

risks.risk: Exact identity/compatibility is unclear; wrong engine/variant could be supplied.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the engine/part identification plate or stamped engine code and any visible part number label.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unidentified used engine/component with compatibility risk (worst-case: may not fit).

risks.risk: Mileage/low mileage claim cannot be verified from photo 0.
risks.proof: Request ECU/odometer screenshot or a diagnostic report showing mileage/vehicle history.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown mileage (worst-case: higher wear).

risks.risk: “Never opened” cannot be verified remotely; seals/gaskets could have been replaced or it could have been repaired.
risks.proof: Request close-up photos of seals/gasket lines, fasteners, and any tamper marks; include underside/cover junctions.
risks.if_unproven: Price as previously opened/unknown service history (worst-case: reduced value).

risks.risk: Potential shipping/handling damage or missing parts may not be visible in photo 0.
risks.proof: Request multiple-angle photos of connectors, sensors, mounting points, and any cracks/repairs; confirm included accessories.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially damaged/needs inspection (worst-case: deduct for missing/failed parts).

proof_requests: Send a new photo set showing the engine/part code plate or stamped engine code and any part number label.
Send a short video of the engine starting and idling (or a diagnostic scan screenshot with fault codes).
Send ECU/odometer/mileage screenshot or diagnostic report.
Send close-up photos of seals/gaskets and mounting points to support “never opened.”
response.reason: The seller’s reply is only a text assertion; without new photos or diagnostic/running proof, the key claims (working/no knock/low mileage/never opened) remain unverified remotely.
